headline: Nasdaq drops 5.5% as AI stocks lead broad Wall Street sell-off
summary: The Nasdaq index fell 5.52% in its largest daily decline in 19 months, driven by a sell-off in artificial intelligence stocks. The decline erased post-election gains amid investor concerns regarding potential future AI regulations.
why: The Nasdaq is a primary benchmark for technology stocks, and its performance is a key indicator of investor sentiment toward the high-growth AI sector.

impacts.name: Artificial Intelligence
impacts.why: Regulatory fears and profit-taking triggered a broad decline in AI-related equity valuations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The sell-off was driven by investor fears of stricter AI regulation following the Democratic victory in US legislative elections, leading to a rapid unwinding of previous gains.
